sokkel-egui.note: Drawn from the spec: one Tab stop, arrows that move and choose, Space, the dark ground and the radio level with the first line.

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Pick one of a few choices, each a row with its radio, its name and a line saying what choosing it means. The whole row is pressable and the chosen one is filled, so the choice reads at a glance where a bare radio would be easy to miss.

anatomy.list: The rows one under the other, 2 apart: a radio group.
anatomy.row: One choice, the whole of it pressable: the radio, then the label over the description; padded 10 across and 8 down, 12 between the radio and the words, rounded by radius-control. The chosen row is filled.
anatomy.radio: The choice's radio, 16 square and round: an edge in input, filled in primary with a dot in primary-foreground while chosen. Set at the top with a description, 2 down, level with the label's first line.
anatomy.label: The choice's name, text.sm at 500 where it is words; a richer row (a person, a theme's sample) as the app draws it.
anatomy.description: A line under the label: what choosing it means, text.xs in muted-foreground.

options.does: The choices, in order: { value, label, description? }.

label.does: The list's accessible name, where no visible heading names it.

hover.means: The pointer is over a row not chosen.

chosen.means: The chosen row: filled in secondary, its radio filled in primary.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the chosen radio (or the first): the focus outline around the radio.

rest.note: Where the label is words; in the ink of what it stands on.

keyboard.does: Reaches the list at the chosen choice (the first when none is chosen); Tab again leaves it.
Moves to the next choice and chooses it, wrapping.
Moves to the choice before and chooses it, wrapping.

sokkel-ui: A radio group (Base UI's RadioGroup); each row is a label around its radio, so a press anywhere on it chooses.
Settings' theme list (useThemeSettings' themeList) is a ChoiceList whose labels are each theme's sample.
labelledBy names the list by the id of a visible heading (aria-labelledby), where label is not given.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
